reviews.text: Friendly and very professional staff. My pet is in great hands!
Very lovely and professional team ! I would like to say a big thank you to Moyn (sorry If i spelled wrong)for being patient with my cat Pipi you are amazing !
Great practice;) our place to go since babies were babies;)

Really kind, expert and friendly vets who make my cats feel comfortable. Friendly helpful reception staff. Overall a calm and positive experience for my cats every time. The only thing that could improve is Medivet should provide visitor parking permits or a parking bay outside for clients, as every time I come I am scared of getting a parking fine but there’s no alternative if you need to drive!
Vet undertook a thorough examination of my cat and I agrees with the diagnosis and reassured it wasn't anything more serious.
Super nice service
Friendly, caring staff, highly recommend this branch
Lovely vet, local to me, the staff are friendly and knowledgeable. My dog is super nervous and the vet did her best to make him feel safe and comfortable.
SERVICE FROM RECEPTIONIST AND VET EXCELLENT COST A LITTLE OVERPRICED FOR A PENSIONER, . OVER ALL FRIENDLY CARING AND VERY LOCAL WITHIN WALKING DISTANCE.
Excellent service really made me and Billy feel welcome on our first visit with direct information and a cheery attitude from all thank you

Both my cats are happily treated here.
The vets never pressure you, or make you feel like a treatment is necessary without adequate information beforehand. They genuinely care, and want you to feel safe and secure with anything and everything they provide for your pets.
My senior cat is soon to be 15, and I only trust Medivet with his care.
I cannot thank the team enough. Dr Hickman and her team are so kind and efficient. I am truly grateful that they are there for my dog. Will definitely recommend to anyone needing a compassionate vet.
Nice practice with knowledgeable  and friendly staff.
Always get a really good service, Doctors are kind and receptionist very helpful.
Very good....
Helpful and thorough vet. Friendly staff. Reasonable cost for a check up etc
I had had very good experience with Medicare west green Road, friendly and welcoming staff, gentle with pets and most importantly always there to listen and give advice. Thank you Medivet Westgreen.!
Nice people. Good service.
Perfect thank you treated with care got the excellent service
Very friendly staff, always helpful

I have been with Medivet for 5 or 6 years now, ever since I got my first cat. I don’t want to say too much about how it was before, but our recent experiences with Dr. Olivia H have been absolutely amazing. My older cat Orca usually gets incredibly stressed during vaccinations, past experiences required 2-3 people with gloves, towels, and holding him down while he screamed and peed himself. It was always a deeply traumatic experience for both of us.
However, our last vaccine appointment was with Dr. Olivia, and it was truly life-changing. Orca just sat there licking a treat, completely stress-free, while she administered the vaccine. It has never been that simple or calm for us.
Dr. Olivia is so patient and understanding; she reassured me and eased all my worries as an anxious cat mom. She is hands-down the best vet I have ever met. Thank you so much for making our visits so much easier, I can't express how grateful I am for this stress-free experience!
Medivet is lucky to have Dr. Olivia, so does all the pet parents and their babies in the area!

Love and appreciation from happy Orca & happy Tutu and their mom
Excellent service as always. Staff are polite and helpful. Definitely recommend the medi vet plan as it helps you out with everything
The staff are lovely and caring.
Vet was wonderful. It was a regular checkup but she explained in a very joyful way everything she was checking on the cats to make sure they are healthy.
Kind and helpful.
Very nice people and a clean and safe space. 100% recommended.

Excellent service provided and very easy to book appointments with extremely friendly staff.
I had my cat's Trevor and Snowy taken there recently for a health checks and would Highly recommend.
The best service provided by far.
We love our vet! Medivet West Green has been really wonderful with our cat and we feel very taken care of. Thank you to the whole staff there.
The team was brilliant 👌👌👌 …

Nice vet but when you switch to this branch from Priory road they increase your pet plan payments. Small amount but with no explanation or rational. They do it because they can. Very disappointing for a loyal customer of 17 years.
Great service. They were very good with my nervous dog.
The team are incredible and we appreciate all of their help. Thank you to the talented team for their ongoing support
I highly recommend this place. I felt surrounded by very professional, friendly, and empathetic people. I would definitely return. Thank you so much for everything, ladies.🙌🏻 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ …
If you ever wanted a sign, this is your sign to avoid and run the opposites direction from this vet. Take it or leave it

When my cat was on the verge of dying, this place tried to turn it into a payday. The overcharging and pressure tactics were disgusting. Taking advantage of people when their pet’s life is at stake is beyond unethical; it’s predatory. Compassion clearly isn’t part of their business model. Avoid at all costs.

Awful place to take your beloved pet, they seem to only care about money. Make sure you double check prices before hand but I highly doubt it’ll ever be accurate as before you know it, they’ll bring you an outrageous bill with a “ estimated price”

Shame on you guys

Avoid at all cost. My cat was attacked by another stray cat and I called them and the best slot they could give me was the next day. I took it. Everytime we take our cat there, they keep us waiting minimum 15 minutes. Today was the appointment and I called them to let them know I will be late and if I can bring her in. The receptionist was extremely rude and trying to put all the blame on me and very aggressive. I haven't seen their friendly or helpful side apart from scolding me over the phone. Their attitude was awful and my cat is on healthcare plan, the funny thing the healthcare plan doesn't even cover the emergency health visits. I immediately canceled the plan and I will take her to another vet. Probably all they care about is money, not the pets since they can treat like this.

Leo had a great experience today. He was greeted warmly by both ladies at reception. They offered treats whilst I filled out the necessary paperwork. Moyen accommodated us very last minute for a nail clipping, she was very knowledgeable and took great care of our boy. Am considering changing pet plan because of the level of service and attentiveness. Thank you again.

The vets and reception staff here are amazing and so caring, doing everything they can with care and love and referring on where they need to, even if it takes hours of calls. Please be wary though if your pet needs to be sent from here to Hendon where you may be fobbed off and gaslighted. Same brand but not same level of care. Staff here at West Green are another level. Please insist for referral to royal veterinary college where possible over being sent to Hendon.

Despite seeing negative reviews,  I  found the surgery very pleasant.  The vet that tended Barney, (Olivia) was very chatty, caring and listened to my needs for Barney, he even got a little welcome pack for him.  No issues.

We couldn't be happier with the Medivet team who where also available and supported us with our dog who sadly passed away aged 15 this week. The doctors have been very compassionate and helped us making the most difficult decision of our lives. We went here for minor grass seed surgeries. Checkups. Vaccinations, and whenever we was worried about more serious conditions. 🙏🏼🫂🌈🐩❤️‍🩹
Staff and vets are always friendly and willing to help. My cat always feels calm going here
Very friendly and caring staff. Tried to get to the bottom of why my cat had diarrhoea and we realised is the brand of food he was getting.

The black lady at the reception was so rude she was keep making faces for no reason. She made me wait 15 minutes for payment and was wondering around drinking water and doing nothing. After paying she didn’t even look at my face even though i said thank you not one word. Horrible lady with an attitude.

This place only seems to care about money, avoid at all costs. Do not ever take your pet like this one if your pet is in real life threatening situation as they will be taking advantage of you when you are in a vulnerable state. They are so useless and don’t deserve to have any clients

AVOIDD!!!!

Absolutely awful experience. This clinic robbed us blind at a time when we were desperate and heartbroken. They demanded £1,000 before doing anything meaningful to help our injured cat, and we saw no real care or urgency from them at all.

When it came time to transfer him to another vet, they completely failed to organise proper transport, leaving us to take our severely injured cat by cab, terrified he might not survive the journey. It was beyond stressful and completely unacceptable.

For the ridiculous amount they charged, we expected basic compassion, professionalism, and proper medical coordination — instead, we got cold attitudes, poor communication, and zero accountability. They made an already traumatic situation ten times worse.

This place only seems to care about money, not animals or people. I wouldn’t trust them with a goldfish, let alone a beloved pet.
Perfect,  nice , professional... just ask for Olivia  she is the Best with a good experience

We cannot thank West Green Practice enough for the incredible care they've provided for our anxious dog, Leo. After a past trauma at a vet where he was hurt during ear medication, Leo became fearful of any veterinary visit, wanting to run away as soon as we arrived.

Recently, he became seriously ill, prompting us to try West Green since it’s conveniently close to home. From our very first visit, the Lady Vet (I’m truly sorry I don’t know how to spell her name correctly) showed exceptional patience and compassion. She spent several minutes working to make Leo feel comfortable, even as he remained anxious and resistant to being examined.

Our second visit today was just as impressive. We saw the same vet, and once again, she took her time, demonstrating a lovely and patient approach that helped Leo feel more at ease. To our delight, he even allowed her to touch his ear—a significant step forward!

We truly feel there's a light at the end of the tunnel, and we're hopeful that one day he will fully trust the examination process. A heartfelt thank you to the entire team for their compassionate and dedicated care. We greatly appreciate it!

They lied to me saying my cat has FIV and charge me 440 pounds for nothing, took the cat was exmined again tested again and no FIV. They make me and the cat suffer for long time for nothing. Not trust worthy.
Great vet practice, the staff are always so welcoming and helpful, they all clearly know what they're doing! We always have good experiences here no matter the reason for the visit.
Very pleasant visit, very friendly staff Thank you so much for looking after My Kitten 🐈‍⬛ …

Had a very nice experience at this vet.  Had a lovely kiwi vet (sorry don't know her name) look after my cat Oscar, who had a lovely nature.  Thanks for also directing me on where to park.  Pro tip - don't go between 2-4pm as the local roads in the area have restrictions, but apart from then it's fine.

Disappointed. I took my cat that I had just found in the street and was very sick to them and I was given the prescription of 4 days of antibiotics that “should be fine”. My cat didn’t have any improvement in her health virose wise and is still sick so I’ve searched for a second advise for professionals and everyone including chat GPT which is nothing but a tool said that 4 days would be too short and the recommended treatment with antibiotics usually is 7 days in this case.
Mistakes happen all the time and I understand that but it kind of look like a way to take money from the people as when I called to ask if they have any discount or better condition for a return appointment being due the same issue that wasn’t treated correctly in the first prescription they said there was none and I would have to pay the full price for the consultation all over again and “this happens, the prescriptions sometimes works and sometimes it doesn’t”. Anyway I’m a fair person and the customer service was very good, I don’t have any complaints regarding that. I just don’t think the professionals are confident with what they’re doing as there’s no sense of assertiveness in such simple situations. The medical history was sent to my email very quickly and I’m moving forward with another Vet Group.
Perfect
Very good 👍 …
Wonderful vets, had a great first experience after we've recently moved there. Very happy with the time and attention we received during our appointment!
We are really happy with Medivet West Green. The staff are friendly, confident and warm. Ideal for our strong minded tom cat.
Nice practice. Friendly and caring staff. When an emergency happened and they were running behind, they still gave my cat the time and attention he needed.

The staff are friendly and professional.  I feel their priority is our pets. While everyone is in business to make a profit I don’t feel that when I take my cat in. I made the right decision. To switch to them.

From the moment I arrived at Medivet West Green, I felt truly welcomed. I was greeted by a lovely lady who went above and beyond—she even helped me clean my travel bag after my puppy had been sick. My pup was absolutely spoiled with cuddles, playtime, and treats from everyone at the clinic… she honestly didn’t want to leave at the end of our visit!

The vet was clear, patient, and very helpful, explaining everything about her first vaccination and worm treatment in detail. I left with plenty of useful information, and it was so quick and easy to book and pay for her second vaccination.

A huge thank you to the whole team for making us feel so welcome, being patient with my toddler while I was in the appointment, and making our first visit such a positive experience. You truly care for both pets and people!
